assumptions: Annual OLS cross-sections are averaged using Fama–MacBeth mechanics and Newey–West lag 5; the paper says the approach is similar to Fama–MacBeth without naming the within-year estimator.
Dollar conversions follow the Xpressfeed formula using GBP as the provider primary/intermediate currency: reported amount / (GBP→CURCD) × (GBP→USD), with USD identity; CURNCD is not the FX origin.

Annual PRCC_F currency is matched to same-date, same-issue SEC_MTH/SEC_MTHPRC evidence: dated HIID first, a unique dated P issue only when HIID is absent, and explicit non-P HIID markers block the route. Monthly and annual price agreement uses 0.00005 precision tolerance without trying both AJEX directions.

Five-year R&D asset is constructed in USD as current plus four lagged reported dollar outlays weighted 1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, and 0.2, then divided once by current end-period CSHO; it does not sum historical per-share amounts. All five observed outlays are required.
PPE is net PPENT/CSHO. Gross future earnings add each future XRD and DP per share, aligned by relative AJEX, before EPS clipping and the five-year SD.

The Table 4 parent-input screen retains current EPSPX, R&D, CapEx, MVE, leverage, BVE deflator, and advertising, as supported by the Table 4 footnote’s reduction from the 42,776 Table 3 sample; the Table 4 outcome is determined by its own donor availability.

limitations: The local Compustat annual vintage is not the paper’s 1997 data vintage; sample counts and estimates are comparisons, not targets.
Historic issue/date coverage and GBP-to-currency FX legs limit some price and dollar constructions; the build reports route, quote, rate, and future-EPS construction attrition separately.

The source’s item54 prose conflicts with the provider crosswalk (CSHPRI=A54, CSHO=A25); Altman’s preferred-equity market value is not available, and the detailed leverage denominator conflicts with equation/table wording.

The annual versus pooled winsorization order and the exact percentile-bin convention are not fully specified. The build uses annual P1/P99 boundaries and documents the table-note/data-section wording conflict.

Capitalized R&D timing within a five-year 20% straight-line life and per-share denominator are not fully specified. The build uses weights 1.0 through 0.2 on t through t−4 and divides the current dollar asset by end-period CSHO, matching net PP&E per share.
Annual coefficient-distribution summaries are computed in memory from asreg by-year OLS fits and exported with estpost tabstat; no annual coefficient dataset is saved.
